issues.title: Lahaina water use permit applications and TIG report

issues.title: Lahaina banyan tree recovery
issues.summary: As of September 9, eight of 16 planned supports have been added to the banyan tree's side branches, about two weeks earlier. An arborist will return with a spider lift for more trimming once it is scheduled. The chair said the tree will stay closed another year and a half, after a July decision that no one will enter its park for two years so it can heal.

issues.title: Proposed Maui County passenger ferry to Molokaʻi and Lānaʻi
issues.summary: At a September 17 community meeting, county staff said the Maui Ferry project is "not a done deal" and that a draft environmental assessment will be released for public comment. issues.title: Mokuʻula restoration master plan
issues.summary: On August 6 the commission took no action on a plan to restore land in a fire-recovery area, though a commissioner voiced strong support. The master plan is being developed until June 2027, and the department is working with the Salvation Army to acquire land it still owns there.
